name: mycli-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is mycli, a command-line client for MySQL and compatible servers. It offers
context-sensitive auto-completion, special commands (favorite queries, output redirection to files and shell
commands, a configurable statement delimiter, saved DSN aliases), shell-style trailing redirects, Polars dataframe
transforms of query results, configuration and login-path file reading, and custom key bindings.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is every Python module of the mycli package except the LLM integration module
mycli/packages/special/llm.py.
The documentation in scope is: README.md, doc/transforms.md, doc/key_bindings.rst, and the module, class and
function docstrings and the `#` comments of the in-scope Python modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings and comments, including their examples.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with mycli's dependencies from pyproject.toml (prompt_toolkit, PyMySQL, sqlparse,
sqlglot, configobj, cli_helpers, Pygments, click, Jinja2 and the others), its dataframe extras (Polars, Altair,
vl-convert-python) and pytest; there is no MySQL server and no network access, and `mycli` is importe
